utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still hearing bits and pieces, so I don’t know the schedule yet. If you’ve heard anything about who’s organizing it, I’d love the update.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I haven’t heard a firm schedule either, but Hana’s the one organizing it. I’m likely to be late, so I’ll check in when I arrive and help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know Hana’s organizing it. I still haven’t heard the start time, but I’ll bring my lamp and see what else I can dig up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help—just send over the details, and I can sort supplies or set up tables.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara—could you set up the tables near the community hall entrance and keep an eye on the supply boxes? I’ll send the details over now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll set up the tables by the community hall entrance and watch the supply boxes. Send the details over when you can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You’re good — I’ve got the basics as I remember them: tools, tape, screws, and a couple extension cords. If you want, I can bring what I’ve got by 9.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’ll bring what I can by 9, and if I find anything else broken I’ll toss it in too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — bring whatever you find, and I’ll have my tools ready by 9.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks, Vik. I’m ready to help sort the donations and pass out flyers, just tell me when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll let you know the time and place, and I’ll keep everyone posted on any changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll keep an ear out for your update — and I’ll try to remember the flyers this time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supplies list and send over anything we’re still short on, plus a few helpers who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just send me the updated list when you can, so I can confirm we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll send the updated supplies list your way soon, and I’ll flag anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to the neighbors nearby and send the repair drive details right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I’m out running errands now, so I’ll swing by and check on the repair drive details and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you checking. Let me know what you find, and I’ll keep spreading the word to folks nearby.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning at the community center — bring any broken stuff over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, Saturday morning works — I’m still a bit worried about boxes and sorting, so I’ll keep an eye out for labels and packing tape too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good call — labels and packing tape will help a lot. I’ll keep the list tight and focus on the fence and porch light first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll pull together the repair-drive list and send over whatever addresses I have, too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — send the list and addresses when you can, and I’ll double-check what still needs fixing before we start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll gather it and send it your way soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — send me the supplies and volunteer names when you have them, and I’ll keep the fence and porch light at the top of the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll gather the supplies and volunteer names and send them over. The fence and porch light will stay at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list moving and make sure the fence and porch light stay first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I can do that — I’ll keep an eye out for labels, packing tape, and extra boxes, and I’ll let you know right away if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate you keeping an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll ask around and let you know if I spot anything useful for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still waiting on the details — who’s organizing it, and what repairs are they planning?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep it simple: I’m organizing the drive, and we’re focusing on the basic repairs on the list. I’ll have the details ready by 9.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Eli — I’ll check back at 9 for the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll check what’s left and send you the list. If you can, aim for later today after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — send me the list, and I’ll aim for later today after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll send the list as soon as I check what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word to the neighbors nearby and let them know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks—just to confirm, you’ll definitely let the neighbors know, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let the neighbors nearby know about the repair drive right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll swing by while I’m out and check on the repair drive, then I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — keep me posted, and I’ll pass along any updates to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m headed out now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Let’s keep it simple: bring the tools by 9, and I’ll have the list ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—I’ll bring the tools by 9 and be ready to start with the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Rey — I’ll have the list ready and we can start with the porch step at 9.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to confirm the repair list first, then we can divide up what’s left. If you arrive late, just check in with me and I’ll get you oriented quickly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll check in with you if I’m running late, and I’ll keep my schedule flexible once the repair list is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — once we confirm the list, I’ll help sort out the rest and keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still just hearing bits and pieces, but I’ll bring my old lamp and see what else I can find. Have you heard what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not yet — I’m still checking the details. I’ll send you the start time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out, and let me know if you hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll gather the list and any addresses I have, then send it over to you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—send it when you can, and I’ll jump in once I get there. If I’m late, I’ll check in and help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll send it over as soon as I’ve got everything together. Thanks for jumping in, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I might’ve missed the update again—what’s the current list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We still need enough boxes, plus labels and packing tape so we can sort everything properly. If you hear of any extras, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — boxes, labels, and packing tape. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I find any extras.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you send me the list of folks who still need a hand, along with their addresses if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I don’t have the full list handy, but I can check with Rosa and send over what I get. The fence and porch light are still the top priorities.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Leo — please check with Rosa and send me whatever you get. I’ll keep the fence and porch light at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam—if you could share the repair drive details with nearby neighbors, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word to nearby neighbors and let them know the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. That really helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m on it — I’ll keep checking for labels, packing tape, and any spare boxes. If I hear anything useful, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess — that helps. Can you also tell me who’s coordinating the repair drive and when it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and find out who’s coordinating it and the exact timing. If I hear back soon, I’ll come tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the porch step was first, wasn’t it? I can point you to Mrs. Alvarez’s place, and maybe we can tackle that faucet after.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — the porch step first sounds right. I’ll check the supply list and send over anything we’re short on, plus a couple of helpful names.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be a big help. I’ll meet you at Mrs. Alvarez’s place and keep an eye out for the faucet parts after we handle the step.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I can bring the tools over and keep it simple for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Gus — thanks. I’m still setting the time, and I’ll send it to you as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just send me the time when it’s set, and I’ll bring the tools over.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
